intent: One compact dock, alternative uses: wirelessly power clock assembly via removable receiver foot; remove clock and stand for phone wireless charging; alternatively use side USB-C output. One device at a time.
prompt: Edit and extend the supplied compact Neo modular clock concept into a refined premium product design presentation showing THREE ALTERNATIVE USE MODES of THE SAME compact reusable charging base. Layout: one large left panel (about 60 percent width) and two stacked smaller right panels, warm light desk background, thin white gutters, restrained high quality typography. Minimal titles: left 'CLOCK', upper right 'WIRELESS', lower right 'USB-C'. Overall small title 'NEO • ONE DOCK, THREE WAYS'. Footer 'ONE DEVICE AT A TIME • DESIGN CONCEPT'. Preserve existing rectangular clock screen with EXACTLY THREE modules flush across top: plain AI + Wi-Fi cartridge left, centered camera lens/shutter, environment sensor right. EXACTLY TWO vertical ear modules: audio grille left, warm light right. Retain brushed aluminum, black glass, clean minimal style. MAIN CLOCK panel: attached screen clock rests on a SINGLE short rear support fixed to a thin horizontal receiver shoe. This shoe and support belong to the clock and detach WITH IT. Shoe is centered on compact base flat top, transmitting wireless power upwards to shoe underside. No pogo pins. Base is LOW rounded rectangle in brushed aluminum, about 65 percent the screen width, top a continuous flat dark nonmetallic pad, no extended accessory shelf. All clock modules remain attached to screen. UI time 09:41, small video portrait, temperature/humidity optional. Upper right WIRELESS panel: clock, support and receiver shoe COMPLETELY ABSENT; the EXACT SAME small base has a perfectly FLAT top and ONE smartphone resting flat centered over its wireless charging area, screen shows charging indicator. No fixed upright neck remaining on base, no other device in scene. Lower right USB-C panel: same small base, its flat top EMPTY, with ONE phone placed beside it on the desk connected by a short cable from visible side USB-C output marked 'OUT'. Rear power input lead can discreetly leave each base. No second device, no clock in phone panels. These panels show alternatives, never simultaneous charging. Do not enlarge base to fit a whole phone if slight phone overhang is natural. Add a tiny clean explanatory line underneath main panel 'Lift off clock + stand to reuse the flat charging surface' if legible. No exploded internals, no engineering certification marks or power ratings. Strong compact practical geometry, realistic perspective and consistent object design across all panels.
